text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. speaker: Doctor
text: Given your symptoms and sexual history, I suspect an infection or pelvic inflammatory disease. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis and Urine Culture.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the urinalysis is normal, I need to rule out gynecological causes like PID or an ectopic pregnancy. Are you currently experiencing any abnormal vaginal discharge, fever, or irregular bleeding?

text: My main symptom is Severe abdominal pain and cramping. I also have Nausea, Vomiting, Pain with urination, Burning pain during intercourse.

text: To help differentiate between gynecological and gastrointestinal causes, have you had a confirmed negative pregnancy test recently? Also, does the pain worsen with movement or when you press on specific areas of your abdomen?

speaker: Doctor
